name: When should I call a professional for blood cleanup instead of cleaning it myself?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for blood cleanup instead of cleaning it myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should always call a professional for any significant blood spill or when blood is present due to trauma, accident, or unattended death. Blood and bodily fluids can carry dangerous pathogens not visible to the naked eye. Attempting to clean these incidents yourself without proper training, personal protective equipment, and specialized disinfectants can expose you to serious health risks and may not fully eliminate contamination, leaving behind biohazards and odors. Professionals ensure safety and thoroughness.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional for any significant blood spill, trauma, or unattended death scenes to avoid health risks and ensure complete biohazard removal.
